labour.title: Statistischer Bericht – Kostenstrukturerhebung im Baugewerbe – 2024, Tabelle 44253-01
labour.basis: Personnel expenses (Personalaufwendungen: gross wages and salaries plus statutory and other social security costs) as a share of production value (Produktionswert, EBS definition), legal units with 20 or more employees, 2024. Destatis publishes both in euro; the share is computed by sitebots. This is the last edition by legal units: Destatis discontinued the report and publishes future results only for enterprises (EU definition) in GENESIS-Online 48112. The 2021 special evaluation also reported five-digit subclasses that this report no longer has, for example carpentry and engineered timber construction (WZ 43.91.2, Zimmerei und Ingenieurholzbau) at 29.2 % of gross output in 2021.

ake2024.basis: Total labour costs (lcstruct D) and wages and salaries (D11) per hour, enterprises with 10 or more employees (sizeclas GE10), apprentices included, euro, survey year 2024. The 2020 cells of this dataset equal GENESIS 62411-0002 'Nettoarbeitskosten je geleistete Stunde', Insgesamt, to the cent (F 31.16, 41: 34.26, 42: 33.80, 43: 29.65), so it is the same survey and concept.

tariff.title: Tarifvertrag zur Regelung der Löhne und Ausbildungsvergütungen im Baugewerbe (TV Lohn/West) and (TV Lohn/Ost), both vom 14. Juni 2024, § 2 Abs. 9 (Löhne ab 1. April 2026)
tariff.publisher: Zentralverband des Deutschen Baugewerbes, Hauptverband der Deutschen Bauindustrie, IG BAU (parties to the agreement); text as printed in the IG BAU brochure 'Bauhauptgewerbe – Tarifverträge 2024'
tariff.basis: Hourly wages per wage group (Lohngruppe) for wage earners in construction firms covered by the BRTV (Bauhauptgewerbe: shell trades such as masonry, concrete, carpentry, road building, tiling, plastering). TL = Tarifstundenlohn, BZ = Bauzuschlag 5.9 % of TL (compensates site changes and weather), GTL = TL + BZ, the wage per paid site hour. From 1 April 2026 the Ost table equals the West table. Binding only where both sides are bound by the agreement (it is not declared generally binding; IG BAU: 'Den Anspruch ... haben nur Mitglieder der IG BAU'). Regional Bezirkslohntarifverträge may differ (§ 2 Abs. 6 ff., § 8; e.g. Hamburg Fertigbau +0.04 EUR, § 3 Abs. 2), and § 9 Abs. 3 allows company agreements up to 4 % below. In force since 1 April 2024, first terminable to 31 March 2027 (§ 10 Abs. 1). The Land Berlin has its own agreement, not checked here; IG BAU states the wages apply 'bundesweit einheitlich' from 1 April 2026 (flyer March 2026, https://igbau.de/Binaries/Binary22699/BHG-April2026-Ost-West-Angleichung.pdf).
